data.one_liner: Flutter widget to pick, re-order, and remove multiple images in a grid view.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete widget and controller to handle selecting multiple images from the device, displaying them in a customizable grid view, and supporting re-ordering via drag-and-drop. It delegates actual image picking to external packages like image_picker or file_picker.
use_when: You need a UI component for users to upload and manage multiple images (like a gallery or photo post screen).
You want users to be able to drag and drop to re-order selected images.
avoid_when: You only need a simple single-image picker without a management grid UI.
You want an out-of-the-box native image selection implementation without writing custom picker callback logic.
strengths: Supports drag-and-drop re-ordering of selected images out of the box.
Fully customizable UI for items, initial container, and add-more buttons.
Flexible picker integration allowing any picker plugin like image_picker or file_picker.
weaknesses: Requires writing your own bridge/callback logic to connect an underlying image picker plugin.
Lacks built-in image cropping or heavy editing capabilities.
data.setup_notes: Add the package and a separate image picking package like image_picker or file_picker to pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need a standard native single or multi-image picker without a custom re-orderable grid interface.
